title: Conveyor belt acceleration time
description: Essential: The student must correctly compute the time for the block to accelerate to the belt's speed (t₁ = 1 s).

title: Conveyor belt constant speed time
description: Essential: The student must correctly compute the time for the block to travel the remaining belt length at constant speed (t₂ = 0.5 s).

title: Total time on belt
description: Essential: The student must correctly sum the acceleration and constant speed times to find the total time for part (1) (t = 1.5 s).

title: Incline acceleration analysis
description: Important: The student must correctly apply Newton's second law to find the block's deceleration on the incline (a₂ = 6 m/s²).

title: Maximum incline distance
description: Important: The student must correctly use kinematics to find the maximum distance the block rises on the incline (sₘ = 1/3 m).

title: Return conveyor belt analysis
description: Important: The student must correctly analyze the block's motion back onto the belt, finding the leftward deceleration (a₃ = 2 m/s²) and displacement.

title: Total distance calculation
description: Essential: The student must correctly compute the total distance traveled in 4.5 seconds (s = 5 m).

title: Sign error in friction
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student uses the wrong sign for friction during acceleration on the belt or return motion.

title: Energy conservation misuse
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly applies energy conservation, ignoring the non-conservative work done by friction on the belt.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Award if the student explicitly shows unit analysis or converts all quantities to consistent SI units.
